domain_setting: A calm, practical family nursery, shared playroom, and safe neighborhood playground. Baby-care items are clean and gentle; toys appear in tidy shelves, on a play mat, or in outdoor play scenes.
recurring_scale_anchors: Use safe, age-appropriate baby-care objects and toys in a warm, uncluttered nursery or play space.
Distinguish small handheld objects by their silhouettes and intended use; make the focal item large enough to read at card size.
Use soft pastel fabrics alongside clear ink outlines and one or two brighter accents; avoid text, labels, or readable screens.
Outdoor equipment belongs in a sunny playground with safe surfaces and children shown at appropriate scale.

polysemy_resolution_table.baby equipment: A small collection of practical infant-care supplies, not a single toy.
polysemy_resolution_table.babygro: A long-sleeved footed one-piece sleepsuit, following the baby-clothing group.
polysemy_resolution_table.bodysuit / onesie / romper suit: Bodysuit is a sleeveless close-fitting underlayer with crotch snaps; onesie is a short-sleeved snap-crotch one-piece; romper suit is a short-legged outfit; keep each silhouette distinct.
polysemy_resolution_table.bottle / baby bottle: Bottle is a plain household bottle; baby bottle has a narrow neck and feeding teat.
polysemy_resolution_table.potty: A small child-training potty, following the baby-equipment group rather than the adjective meaning silly.
polysemy_resolution_table.mobile: A hanging nursery toy above a crib, not a phone or the adjective meaning portable.
polysemy_resolution_table.balloon: A lightweight party balloon toy, following the toys group rather than a hot-air balloon.
polysemy_resolution_table.kite: A toy flown on a string outdoors, following the playground group rather than the bird of prey.
polysemy_resolution_table.rattle: A handheld infant shaker toy, following the toys group rather than the verb for making noise.
polysemy_resolution_table.baby carriage / stroller: Baby carriage or pram is a deeper enclosed bassinet-style carriage; stroller or buggy is a lighter folding pushchair.
polysemy_resolution_table.soft toy / stuffed animal / teddy bear: Soft toy is a generic fabric toy, stuffed animal is a plush animal, and teddy bear is specifically a toy bear.
polysemy_resolution_table.building blocks / building bricks: Building blocks are solid wooden shapes; building bricks are interlocking plastic construction pieces.

contrast_notes.changing mat / changing table: A changing mat is portable and padded; a changing table is raised furniture with storage and a safety rail.
contrast_notes.baby carriage / stroller: Show a deep covered pram versus a compact folding pushchair with a seated child.
contrast_notes.crib / Moses basket / playpen: Crib is a full-sized fixed baby bed, Moses basket is a small portable infant bassinet, playpen is a bounded play area.
contrast_notes.ball / balloon: Ball is round, heavier, and kicked or thrown; balloon is light, tied, and floating upward.
contrast_notes.soft toy / stuffed animal / teddy bear: Use a soft fabric shape, a generic plush animal, and a recognizable plush bear respectively.
contrast_notes.building blocks / building bricks: Use non-connecting wooden cubes for blocks and interlocking studded plastic pieces for building bricks.
contrast_notes.slide / mobile: Slide is playground equipment for children to climb and glide down; mobile is a hanging crib decoration.
